description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different systems in processing audio and noise. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 60, while the horizontal axis lists three systems: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The blue bars represent the accuracy of the systems in audio, and the purple bars represent the accuracy in noise. The Qwen2-Audio-Instruct system has an accuracy of approximately 30% in audio and around 20% in noise. The Audio-Reasoner system shows an accuracy of about 40% in audio and roughly 30% in noise. The Qwen-2.5-Omni system has the highest accuracy in audio, close to 60%, and around 40% in noise. The chart does not provide any additional information on the scale type, value range, units, or tick label interval.
